verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, so background automations (CI runners, scheduled jobs, autonomous agent runs) are a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no first-party way to set up automations that run on their own. Webhooks, the REST API and CLI are developer building blocks, and Buildkite builds and GitHub Actions results come from external CI. GitHub sync and the hand-off to an external coding agent are adjacent features, not user-configured background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
